project_type: Laravel 11 tutor marketplace, no frontend build step — vanilla CSS/JS inline in Blade views, Alpine.js from CDN
build_system: Composer. No webpack/vite. CSS is inline <style> per view. Assets served from /public/storage via symlink.
test_framework: None configured. Manual browser verification is the test method.
verification_instructions: 1) php artisan migrate  2) php artisan route:list | findstr library  3) php artisan view:clear && php artisan config:clear  4) Load /library in browser  5) Load /blog — should 301 to /library  6) Load /admin/library  7) Load /tutor/library as tutor
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell environment. Use findstr not grep. All artisan commands run from the tutor-platform directory: c:\Users\Administrator\Downloads\mediacity.co.in-2026-10-13\mediacity.co.in-2026-10-13\tutor-platform
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Match existing code style: inline CSS per view, no Blade components, no service layer — direct Eloquent queries in controllers are the pattern used throughout.
key_patterns: 1) Tutor dashboard views are standalone HTML files with a duplicated inline sidebar (no layout file) — copy sidebar block from pages/tutor/group-sessions/index.blade.php. 2) Admin views use @extends('layouts.admin'). 3) Public views use @include('partials.nav') + @include('partials.footer'). 4) CSS variables: --ink:#15281F, --trust-blue:#0A64BC, --coral:#E8522A, --gold:#EEBE15, --mint:#10B981, --muted:rgba(21,40,31,.55), --hair:rgba(21,40,31,.1), --sidebar:#111C16. 5) Sidebar items use class sb-item / sb-item active. 6) Route names follow pattern: admin.X, tutor.X, X.index/show/create/store/destroy.
directory_structure: tutor-platform/ — app/Http/Controllers/{Admin,Tutor}/ for namespaced controllers; app/Models/; database/migrations/; resources/views/pages/{admin,blog,tutor/group-sessions,tutor-subjects}/; resources/views/partials/; resources/views/layouts/; routes/web.php (single flat file)
